title: Extend OnBeforeCheckBankAcc to skip specific bank reversal checks
summary: The OnBeforeCheckBankAcc event in the Reversal Entry table gains two Boolean parameters that let extensions skip the Open and Statement No. validations independently when reversing bank account ledger entries.
key_points: Two new Boolean parameters added to OnBeforeCheckBankAcc event to control Open and Statement No. validation checks
Extensions can now skip specific bank reversal checks without handling the entire validation
Event signature extended with trailing parameters while maintaining compatibility with existing subscribers
Changes applied across all regional layers (W1, APAC, BE, CH, ES, FR, IT, RU, SE)
New tests added to verify skipping individual checks during bank entry reversal
quote: This change lets extensions independently skip the Open and Statement No. validations when reversing a bank account ledger entry.
